Stub comments in indexer_deployment_core.rs point to each. global_rules: Keep main green: every step is independently committable; scenarios of later steps stay #[ignore]. Remove one ignore at a time, see it RED for the right reason, then GREEN.

RED gate (distill/red-classification.md): most layer-3 scenarios first fail at their setup pass until `trigger` lands (01-03). When enabling a scenario, re-check it fails on ITS OWN assertion before implementing.
Build the binaries before acceptance tests: cargo build -p openlore-indexer -p cli (and -p openlore-review-app in 03-01). The live harness spawns target/debug binaries.

After any change to a shared crate (ports, appview-domain, adapter-index-store, adapter-xrpc-query-server, xtask, tests/acceptance/support) run dependent suites NARROWLY (cargo test -p <crate> / cargo test -p cli --test <target>), never the whole workspace on the host; CI verifies the full suite.
Trunk-based: commit to main, no PRs. .github/workflows changes are pushed over SSH (gh credential helper lacks workflow scope).

Orchestrator decisions (distill/wave-decisions.md 1-5) are binding: fault seam OPENLORE_INDEXER_TEST_FAULT debug-only (release refuses start); review-app caps REVIEW_DB_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB / REVIEW_DB_THREADS; render-dids.sh honours INDEXER_CONFIG_DIR, chown only as root, no bats; control socket must be an absolute path; CLI prints 'Network index unavailable' on a 500.

phases.name: Thin slice: serve owns the index and runs triggered passes
phases.description: One store handle per process with a read/write port split, an in-serve pass runner on a dedicated thread with single-flight, the `trigger` verb over a Unix control socket (dispatched before config and store open), a guaranteed single pass_summary and GET /healthz. Ends with the walking skeleton (WS-0..2) green.

steps.name: One store handle per process and read/write port split (B1, B7, B10)
steps.description: serve opens index.duckdb once and shares that handle across probe, search and (next step) the pass runner. IndexReadPort (queries) is split from the write port (probe, upsert). The search handler moves into its own openlore-indexer module holding only the read port. serve/main doc comments describe real behaviour.

steps.name: In-serve pass runner on a dedicated thread with single-flight (B2, B13 thread)
steps.description: serve hosts a pass runner that executes the existing ingest pass body on its own OS thread with its own runtime, sharing the one store handle. A pure single-flight transition decides start / busy (naming the running pass) / free, and the runner publishes a read-only PassStatus view.

PassStatus is exposed to readers as a view with no setter reachable outside the runner

trigger needs only the socket variable; a stale socket file from a crash never blocks the next start (PS-16, PS-24)
A pass is never refused because search is busy; a pass with nothing new changes nothing Maria sees; the control module binds only a Unix socket, never TCP (PS-11, PS-25, XD-5)

LESSONS: run dependent suites narrowly (indexer_ingest, appview_core, appview_search, search_hide_retracted, review_app_self_attested_readers, indexer_per_did_*, indexer_pass_core, and openlore-review-app suites when touching the review app); build openlore-indexer before acceptance tests; keep main green; .github/workflows changes push over SSH.

phases.name: Review-app caps, deploy artefacts, CI image and tofu
phases.description: Review-app DuckDB caps (B11), the host deploy artefacts (compose, Caddy site, systemd timers, render-dids.sh, deploy.sh, runbook) and the CI image job plus tofu (IAM, log group, metric filters, 3 alarms, SSM parameter). No tofu apply; no tofu-aws-pds module bump (operator follow-up).

steps.name: Review-app DuckDB caps with read-back probe and capped compose (B11)
steps.description: The review app reads REVIEW_DB_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB (16..=1024) and REVIEW_DB_THREADS (1..=4), applies them when opening its DuckDB, and refuses to start (health.startup.refused naming the variable) when out of range or when the read-back does not match. Its compose gains init, the 48 MB / 1-thread caps and mem_limit 192m.
criteria: Caps within range start the review app; 15, 1025, non-numeric memory and 0, 5 threads refuse startup naming the variable (RAC-1)
The probe reads memory_limit and threads back and refuses when they differ from configuration
Review-app compose runs with init, the two cap variables at 48 and 1, and mem_limit 192m (XP-2)
Existing review-app suites pass unchanged
steps.test_command: cargo build -p openlore-review-app && cargo test -p openlore-review-app --test review_app_resource_caps && cargo test -p openlore-review-app && cargo test -p adapter-review-store && cargo test -p xtask --test indexer_deployment_platform && cargo test -p cli --test review_app_self_attested_readers
steps.implementation_notes:
TEST PARADIGM (mandatory): Unit tests for this step MUST be written as property-based tests using proptest strategies + state-delta assertions over a declared universe. Single-example unit tests are FALLBACK only — document why in a `// bypass:` comment if used. Acceptance scenarios are framed as properties where the contract supports it; classic scenarios are fallback. Integration and E2E tests REMAIN single-example — they verify wiring, not invariants.
STAGE CONTEXT: NEW code = Stage 0 (paradigm from day zero).

Names fixed by decision 2. Range validation is a pure function (PBT: accepts exactly its range, mirroring CORE-8). Independent of phases 01-02 (can run in parallel). Compose edit is a deploy artefact covered by XP-2; the 192m figure is confirmed at the re-measure gate, not here. Do not change the review app's unguarded IdentityLookup or anything else in its composition root.
LESSONS: run dependent suites narrowly (indexer_ingest, appview_core, appview_search, search_hide_retracted, review_app_self_attested_readers, indexer_per_did_*, indexer_pass_core, and openlore-review-app suites when touching the review app); build openlore-indexer before acceptance tests; keep main green; .github/workflows changes push over SSH.

steps.name: Host deploy artefacts: compose, Caddy site, timers, render-dids.sh, deploy.sh, runbook
steps.description: deploy/indexer/ mirrors the review-app layout: one serve container in production posture, index.caddy exposing only search and /healthz, a 15-minute Persistent pass timer (render then trigger) and a health timer, render-dids.sh that renames the file never the directory and keeps the last good list, deploy.sh with digest, CI-green and cosign gates, and the README runbook.
criteria: The indexer container has exactly its two mounts and the production posture (XP-1)
The public site serves only POST search and GET /healthz over HTTPS with an 8 KB body cap (XP-3)

The pass runs every 15 minutes, never stacks, survives a reboot and outlives the 25-minute deadline; the health line reports not_live 1 when FilterLogEvents fails, and 0 when all is well (XP-4, XP-13)
Two list edits replace the file and never the directory; a failed or empty read keeps the last good list and never fails the pass (XP-5, XP-6)
Deploys by tag, branch or short sha, unsigned digests and red-CI shas are refused before any tool or host is touched (XP-7, XP-8)
steps.test_command: cargo test -p xtask --test indexer_deployment_platform && bash -n deploy/indexer/deploy.sh deploy/indexer/host/*.sh
steps.implementation_notes:
EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: declarative deploy artefacts and shell scripts, verified by structural xtask tests and real bash runs with PATH stubs; no Rust domain logic. Compensate with property-based test at unit level on adjacent slot: CORE-4 (02-01) covers every list text render-dids.sh can write, CORE-8 (02-03) covers every env value compose sets.

Inputs: devops/infrastructure-integration.md, platform-architecture.md, monitoring-alerting.md, observability-design.md (status query). Decision 3: render-dids.sh honours INDEXER_CONFIG_DIR, chown only when EUID=0, no bats file. Staging FILE in the same dir, chmod 0444, rename the file, touch .rendered-at, ship indexer.dids.render_failed on failure, exit 0. container_name openlore-indexer (R-IXD-D7). health-timer.sh (review F3; observability-design §4) emits one indexer.host.health line per run with not_live = 1 IF running = 0 (container openlore-indexer not running, incl. absent/OOM-killed) OR healthz_ok = 0 (/healthz through Caddy not 200 with status ok; a 503 store_unusable counts) OR summary_45m = 0 (no indexer.ingest.pass_summary in the shipped log group in the last 45 min via aws logs filter-log-events; ANY aws/FilterLogEvents error sets summary_check = error and summary_45m = 0: fail closed) OR dids_age_s > 7200 (.rendered-at missing = infinitely old); else 0. That one field is the A3 input (architecture §9 'indexer_live = 0' == not_live = 1). Testability (XP-13): honours INDEXER_CONFIG_DIR and INDEXER_STATE_DIR, resolves docker/curl/aws from PATH, prints the line on stdout, tolerates no /proc, always exits 0. Hung-process guard: 3 failed /healthz in a row -> docker restart. deploy.sh: install/deploy/status/rollback modelled on deploy/review-app/deploy.sh; refuse non-digest refs before any tool runs. Add the indexer to the replacement runbook's redeploy step.
LESSONS: run dependent suites narrowly (indexer_ingest, appview_core, appview_search, search_hide_retracted, review_app_self_attested_readers, indexer_per_did_*, indexer_pass_core, and openlore-review-app suites when touching the review app); build openlore-indexer before acceptance tests; keep main green; .github/workflows changes push over SSH.

steps.name: CI image job, host checks and tofu: IAM, log group, metric filters, 3 alarms, SSM parameter
steps.description: A runtime-only distroless arm64 Dockerfile; ci.yml indexer-build and indexer-image jobs (serve-smoke, trivy, push, cosign sign, SBOM, build provenance); deploy-pds-check indexer-host job; prod indexer.tf (log group, metric filters, saved queries, exactly 3 alarms on the existing topic with ok_actions, SSM parameter); bootstrap indexer-iam.tf least privilege. Validate only, never apply.
criteria: Exactly three alarms page the existing topic and announce recovery (XP-9)
Metric filters and saved queries read only the structural events the index emits (XP-10)
The host role may read the DID-list parameter, write its own log group and FilterLogEvents on that group only (the health heartbeat), nothing more (XP-11)
The image is a signed, non-root, distroless build from CI with a blocking serve-smoke; host checks cover deploy/indexer/** (XP-12)
tofu fmt/validate pass for both roots; no apply and no tofu-aws-pds module bump
steps.test_command: cargo test -p xtask --test indexer_deployment_platform && tofu fmt -check -recursive deploy/tofu && tofu -chdir=deploy/tofu/environments/prod init -backend=false && tofu -chdir=deploy/tofu/environments/prod validate && tofu -chdir=deploy/tofu/bootstrap init -backend=false && tofu -chdir=deploy/tofu/bootstrap validate
steps.implementation_notes:
EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: CI workflow, Dockerfile and OpenTofu HCL are declarative infrastructure verified by structural xtask tests and tofu validate. Compensate with property-based test at unit level on adjacent slot: CORE-5 (01-04) pins the exit_code/cause contract the metric filters key on, CORE-9 (02-04) pins the route allowlist the serve-smoke and Caddy mirror.

Inputs: devops/ci-cd-pipeline.md §3/§5, monitoring-alerting.md, infrastructure-integration.md §5. serve-smoke expectations = AS-56 (trigger exits 3 on did:web:smoke.invalid, one pass_summary, 8 KB not 413 / 9 KB 413, stop < 3 s). Same distroless and trivy pins as the review app. deploy-pds-check: drop the bats step (decision 3), keep shellcheck, compose config, posture guard, systemd-analyze, caddy validate. Alarms: A1 2x exit 3, A2 exit 2 or startup.refused/store.unusable, A3 no summary 45 min (missing = breaching) or indexer_live=0; *_alarms_enabled toggle. IAM: ssm:GetParameter on /openlore/prod/indexer(/*), logs CreateLogStream/PutLogEvents/DescribeLogStreams plus FilterLogEvents (DEVOPS U-1, approved) on /openlore/prod/indexer only; no CreateLogGroup, PutMetricData, SSM write or '*'.
